response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in modern web technologies, TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. However, he falls significantly short of the mandatory requirements for this role. He lacks the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ development on Windows, possessing only a brief 7-month stint using C/C++ nearly a decade ago. Additionally, he lacks deep expertise in SQL Server/Oracle and traditional fixed income or capital markets systems, making him a poor fit for this specific position despite his overall strong engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Over 15 years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on software craftsmanship, TDD, and CI/CD pipelines.
Possesses some financial domain exposure from his time at RIDE Capital working on investment practices.
Excellent communication and leadership skills demonstrated through conference talks, technical workshops, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Fails to meet the mandatory 5–10 years of C++ development requirement, having only 7 months of professional C/C++ experience from 2014-2015.
Lacks enterprise database experience with SQL Server or Oracle, focusing primarily on MongoDB and MySQL in recent roles.
Missing required domain expertise in Fixed Income, Derivatives, or traditional Investment Banking systems.
